rationale: Akt and ERK are mutually reinforcing in epithelial cells, so removing either one drains the other: pERK falls when Akt is inhibited and pAkt falls when MEK is inhibited. The compounds were added as single short pulses into a Matrigel culture, so by the day of harvest each had washed out of its own node, leaving pAkt T308 under the Akt inhibitor and pERK1/2 under UO126 back at their untreated levels.
